title: Ramp's internal AI stack: agents, sandboxes, and an AI-first BI tool
description:
How Ramp's internal AI agents crossed a million sessions, built by one data platform engineer. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Jay Sobel, a data platform engineer at Ramp, describes internal AI: setting up the whole organization, from engineers to sales, with agents and tools grounded in company data. Inspect, Ramp's sandboxed coding-agent ticket system, has passed a million sessions, and WaveDash renders every dashboard as a SQL file in a repo. Ramp deliberately avoids locking into a single AI lab's models to keep its options open.

In this session you'll learn:
• How sandboxed coding agents scale across a company
• How code-based dashboards fit an agent workflow
• Why Ramp avoids single-vendor model lock-in

Speaker: Jay Sobel, data platform engineer, Ramp

Learn more about dbt and AI: https://www.getdbt.com/product/ai
